火龙一出，宗主的威压就像是被击溃一般，他不可置信的往后退一步，在火龙快要靠近的时候，忙慌捏诀，在周身布下一个结界。

然而结界并没有什么用，火龙身躯绕着他的结界收紧，结界被火焰烧出裂缝……

“阿辞。”时笙唤了一声。

凤辞迟疑了下，抬手将火龙召回的同时，打出了几枚火焰凝聚而成的利刃，穿过结界的裂缝，射入宗主的腹部。

“唔……”宗主只觉得有一股蛮横的力量凭空挤进他身体，在他身体中横冲直撞，似乎要将他撕裂一般。

从开始到结束，不过几秒的时间，众人反应过来，宗主已经捂着腹部，单膝跪在地上了。

“宗主！”

“大胆，你是何人竟敢对宗主动手。”反应过来的人，纷纷上前，拿出武器对着时笙和凤辞。

“讲道理啊你们，明明是他先对我动手的。”时笙将凤辞拉到自己身边，略带讽刺的道：“难道你们不知道我不过筑基？就宗主那威压扫过来，我还能活吗？就许州官放火不许百姓点灯是吧？”

丫的他根本就没有要听她解释的意思，随她怎么说，这个罪肯定是担定了。

就如同剧情中下药的那次，就算她有人证，最后不还是认定是她做的吗？

“你是缥缈宗的弟子，怎么可以忤逆犯上，就算宗主惩罚你，那也是你先对同门动手在先。”

“玉箫，你看看你教的好徒儿！先是残害同门，现在还对宗主动手，必须严惩！”

“逐出师门都为过，当年师父就说过，此女命格不详，会给师弟带来祸端，师弟偏生不信，现在好了，残杀同门不说，还要忤逆犯上。”

玉箫神色不变，面对那么多人的质疑，他依旧站在时笙前面，“宗主对小殊动手在先，小殊不过是保护自己。”

“你……你……师弟啊，你怎么就这么糊涂！”

时笙有些诧异的看向玉箫，她的命格不详吗？

剧情中，原主也确实给玉箫带去了祸端。

这些人……

也不知道叶清秋给他们说了什么，连解释都不听她说，就急着定了她的罪。

凤辞见时笙脸色不好，暗红色的眸子里闪过狠戾，一字一句的道：“把叶清秋交出来，否则，他死。”

“放肆！”

“玉箫，你就看着他们胡来？”

“玉箫……”

“你们叫我师父做什么？动手的又不是我师父。”时笙冷嗤一声，“我商殊，今日在这里和玉箫断绝师徒关系，从此互不相干。”

时笙看向玉箫，“师父，对不起，徒儿不孝，以后徒儿会报答你的养育之恩。”

As soon as the fire dragon came out, the pressure of the sect master seemed to be defeated. He took a step back in disbelief. When the fire dragon was about to approach, he hurriedly formed a magic spell and placed a barrier around his body.

However, the barrier was of no use. The fire dragon's body tightened around his barrier, and the barrier was burned with cracks by the flames...

"Aci." Shi Sheng called.

Feng Ci hesitated for a moment, raised his hand to recall the fire dragon, and at the same time fired several sharp blades made of condensed flames, passed through the cracks in the barrier, and shot into the sect leader's abdomen.

"Well..." The sect leader felt that a brute force squeezed into his body out of thin air, rushing through his body, as if it was going to tear him apart.

From the beginning to the end, it only took a few seconds for everyone to realize that the sect leader was already kneeling on the ground with his hands on his abdomen.

"Sect Master!"

"Bold, who are you to dare to attack Zong Zong?" Those who reacted stepped forward and took out their weapons to point at Shi Sheng and Feng Ci.

"Let's be reasonable, you guys, he was the one who attacked me first." Shi Sheng pulled Feng Ci to his side and said with a hint of irony: "Don't you know that I only build the foundation? If the pressure of the sect master is swept away, can I still survive? Just let the state officials set fire and prevent the people from lighting lamps, right?"

Damn, he had no intention of listening to her explanation. No matter what she said, he would definitely be guilty.

Just like the time when she was drugged in the plot, even if she had a witness, wouldn't it be determined that she did it in the end?

"You are a disciple of the Piao Miao Sect. How can you disobey and rebel against me? Even if the sect master punishes you, you will be the first to attack your fellow disciples."

"Yuxiao, look at the good disciple you taught! First he killed his fellow disciples, and now he attacks the sect leader. He must be severely punished!"

"It's too much to expel the disciple. Back then, the master said that this girl's fate was unknown and would bring disaster to the junior fellow apprentice. The junior fellow apprentice didn't believe her. Now it's better. Not only will she kill her fellow disciples, but she will also commit disobedience."

Yuxiao's expression remained unchanged. Faced with so many people's doubts, he still stood in front of Shi Sheng, "The sect master attacked Xiaoshu first, and Xiaoshu was just protecting himself."

"You...you...junior brother, why are you so confused!"

Shi Sheng looked at Yu Xiao with some surprise. Is her fate unknown?

In the plot, the original owner did bring trouble to Yuxiao.

These people...

They didn't know what Ye Qingqiu told them. He didn't even listen to her explanation and rushed to convict her.

When Feng Ci saw Shi Sheng's expression turned ugly, ruthlessness flashed in his dark red eyes, and he said word by word: "Hand over Ye Qingqiu, otherwise, he will die."

"Presumptuous!"

"Yu Xiao, are you just going to watch them do whatever they want?"

"Yu Xiao..."

"What do you call me master? It's not my master who did this." Shi Sheng sneered coldly, "I, Shang Shu, am here today to sever the master-disciple relationship with Yu Xiao, and we will have nothing to do with each other from now on."

Shi Sheng looked at Yuxiao, "Master, I'm sorry, my apprentice is unfilial. I will repay your kindness in raising you in the future."
